title: Neon palette painting: pink, cyan, and sodium yellow done right (and done badly)
excerpt: Pink, cyan, sodium yellow — the cyberpunk neon palette. Why pick two of three, when to break the rule, and how to keep neon-pink rim light from melting a face.
seo_title: Cyberpunk Neon Palette: Pink, Cyan, Sodium Done Right
seo_description: How to paint the cyberpunk neon palette without it looking like every other piece. Two-of-three discipline, rim-light tricks, and the anti-pattern to avoid.
